types.name: Appearance
types.description: An entry in a lineup: someone (or several people) on, or an intermission. A lineup is a venue night's own, built as the night goes, or an event's, built ahead. Each runs in `position` order and can be advanced like a slide deck (advanceLineup).

fields.name: activity
fields.description: A segment or intermission: what runs in the venue's chat while it's on; null for nothing.

fields.name: afterScene
fields.description: A break inside an act: the scene it follows.

fields.name: cameOffAt
fields.description: When advancing (or finishing it) took it off.

fields.name: curtainCallMinutes
fields.description: An act the curtain rises on: places is called this many minutes before it (or once it is up next), and it goes on only on a go (goNoGo). Null: no curtain call.

fields.name: durationMinutes
fields.description: endTiming DURATION: how long it runs once on.

fields.name: endTiming
fields.description: How it ends.

fields.name: endsAt
fields.description: Its set end time; null until close or advanced.

fields.name: endsTo
fields.description: What ending it goes to, as set: an act's scenes unless they say, or a break.

fields.name: entryKind
fields.description: What it is: an act, an intermission or a segment.

fields.name: estimatedMinutes
fields.description: How long it is expected to run: its set length, else an act's scenes or tracks plus other time; null when nothing says.

fields.name: event
fields.description: The event whose lineup it's on, built ahead; null for one on the venue night's own lineup.

fields.name: extraMinutes
fields.description: An act: time beyond its scenes or tracks, as set; null for the default (10 minutes).

fields.name: flexible
fields.description: Whether it stretches or shrinks to bring the show back on time.

fields.name: goNoGo
fields.description: An act's curtain call go/no-go: who is ready. Null without a curtain call, and for anyone not working the show.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Its UUID.

fields.name: kind
fields.description: An act or an intermission. Segments read as INTERMISSION here, for apps built before them (they fail on values they do not know); entryKind has the full kind.

fields.name: lateMinutes
fields.description: How many minutes after its set time it starts, as projected (negative: early); null without a set time.

fields.name: lineup
fields.description: The lineup it's on (doc/LINEUP_MODEL.md): a zone's night or an event's in a zone.

fields.name: maxMinutes
fields.description: The longest it runs when it flexes, as set.

fields.name: minMinutes
fields.description: The shortest it runs when it flexes, as set.

fields.name: missingTracks
fields.description: How many of an act's scenes have no length or track (each counted as 4 minutes in the estimate).

fields.name: night
fields.description: The venue night it is on.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Notes for the crew, in Markdown.

fields.name: people
fields.description: Who's on it, in billing order: two for a duet.

args.name: after
args.description: Returns the elements in the list that come after the specified cursor.

args.name: before
args.description: Returns the elements in the list that come before the specified cursor.

args.name: first
args.description: Returns the first _n_ elements from the list.

args.name: last
args.description: Returns the last _n_ elements from the list.

fields.name: person
fields.description: Who, or the first of them; null for an intermission.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Its place in its lineup's running order, from 0.

fields.name: preshowMinutes
fields.description: An act: its own preshow before it, from doors to the host, in minutes.

fields.name: projectedEndsAt
fields.description: When it is expected off: when it came off, its hard end, else its projected start plus its estimate.

fields.name: projectedStartsAt
fields.description: When it is expected on: when it went on, its hard time, else moved out behind what runs late.

fields.name: role
fields.description: What they are doing; null for an intermission.

fields.name: scenes
fields.description: An act's numbers, in order.

fields.name: songRequest
fields.description: A singer's karaoke signup: the song, artist and who is singing it; null for everything else.

fields.name: startTiming
fields.description: How it starts.

fields.name: startsAt
fields.description: Its set (hard or soft) time, or when an entry with no set time went on; null until then.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Upcoming, on now or done.

fields.name: tasks
fields.description: What has to happen for it: its venue's, event series', event's and talent's task templates, then its own. Null for anyone not working the show.

args.name: includeRemoved
args.description: List the tasks taken off it too (removed true).

fields.name: title
fields.description: An act's billing (a duet's name) or an intermission's label, if it has one.

fields.name: triviaDriver
fields.description: Who moves its trivia along; null unless it runs trivia.

fields.name: triviaReveal
fields.description: When its trivia answers show; null unless it runs trivia.

fields.name: triviaSet
fields.description: The trivia set it runs: its own, else the best match for its event or venue tags. Null unless it runs trivia.

fields.name: venue
fields.description: Where.

fields.name: venueWide
fields.description: A break with an activity: whether it runs for the whole venue, every zone, not just its own.

fields.name: wentOnAt
fields.description: When advancing put it on.

inputFields.name: activity
inputFields.description: A segment or intermission: what runs in the venue's chat while it's on; null for nothing.

inputFields.name: afterSceneId
inputFields.description: A break inside an act: the scene it follows. Null: it sits at its position, between acts.

inputFields.name: curtainCallMinutes
inputFields.description: An act: call places this many minutes before it (or once it is up next) and wait for a go before it goes on. Null: no curtain call.

inputFields.name: durationMinutes
inputFields.description: endTiming DURATION: how long it runs once on.

inputFields.name: endTiming
inputFields.description: How it ends. Defaults to TIME when endsAt is given, CLOSE when it is null.

inputFields.name: endsAt
inputFields.description: When they finish; null until the night ends.

inputFields.name: endsTo
inputFields.description: What ending it goes to: an act's scenes unless they say, or a break. Null: the lineup's setting for an act, the host for a break.

inputFields.name: eventId
inputFields.description: The event at the venue whose lineup it's on, for one built ahead; null for the venue night's own. Its night is then the event's.

inputFields.name: extraMinutes
inputFields.description: An act: time beyond its scenes or tracks (hosting, hellos, an encore), for its estimate. Null: 10 minutes.

inputFields.name: flexible
inputFields.description: Whether it stretches or shrinks to bring the show back on time. Null: intermissions do, the rest do not.

inputFields.name: kind
inputFields.description: An act (the default), an intermission or a segment.

inputFields.name: lineupId
inputFields.description: The lineup it's on (doc/LINEUP_MODEL.md): a zone's night or an event's in a zone. Sets its night and event. Null: the one its night and event say, in the default zone.

inputFields.name: maxMinutes
inputFields.description: The longest it runs when it flexes. Null: no limit.

inputFields.name: minMinutes
inputFields.description: The shortest it runs when it flexes. Null: 5 minutes.

inputFields.name: night
inputFields.description: The venue night, for an entry with no set time. Defaults to the night startsAt falls in, or tonight.

inputFields.name: notes
inputFields.description: Notes for the crew, in Markdown.

inputFields.name: personId
inputFields.description: Who, for one person. An act needs people or a title.

inputFields.name: personIds
inputFields.description: Who, in billing order: several for a duet or group.

inputFields.name: preshowMinutes
inputFields.description: An act: a preshow of this many minutes before it, from doors to the host. Null: none.

inputFields.name: role
inputFields.description: What they are doing. Needed for an act.

inputFields.name: scenes
inputFields.description: An act's numbers, in order; replaces those it has.

inputFields.name: startTiming
inputFields.description: How it starts. Defaults to HARD.

inputFields.name: startsAt
inputFields.description: Its hard or soft time.

inputFields.name: title
inputFields.description: An act's billing or an intermission's label.

inputFields.name: triviaDriver
inputFields.description: Activity TRIVIA: who moves the rounds along. Null: HOST when it has people, else ROOM.

inputFields.name: triviaReveal
inputFields.description: Activity TRIVIA: when answers show. Null: EACH.

inputFields.name: triviaSet
inputFields.description: Activity TRIVIA: the trivia set to run (a Venue.trivia.sets key). Null picks one by the event's or venue's tags.

inputFields.name: venueWide

enumValues.name: TEXT
enumValues.description: Just what they wrote.

enumValues.description: A title, the message as its body and an optional photo. One per room can be pinned under its title.

enumValues.description: One of the audience's events, with the message as a caption.

enumValues.name: PHOTO
enumValues.description: A photo, with the message as a caption.

enumValues.name: SPECIAL
enumValues.description: A title and body that stop showing at endsAt.

enumValues.name: REQUEST
enumValues.description: A song request or karaoke signup (`request`), with the message as a note to the host. Anyone in a venue room may send one while the venue takes them (requestSong).

enumValues.name: PROMPT
enumValues.description: One of the event's chat prompts (`prompt`), posted as the audience. The newest PINNED one shows under the room's title.

fields.name: recordAnalysis
fields.description: Keeps a run of the AI host on one chat message (MessageAnalysis): its ruling, what was done and its deep analysis, for Arbiter to read anywhere without running a model. The message is a feed event (`cursor`), or one on the audience's chat provider (`chatProvider` and `messageId`), e.g. a Discord message. Each call is a new run of its configuration, which wins over the earlier ones, unless `version` names a run to update. A live recordDecision about a message is a run on its own. Nothing is done in the room.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessageRemove

fields.name: removeChatPrompt
fields.description: Removes one of an event's chat prompts, for whoever runs the night: one still to show comes off the list (skipping it); one that's up is taken out of the room for everyone, and stays in the list as shown (takenDown), so it never goes up again.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatPromptRemove

fields.name: removeEventPhoto
fields.description: Removes a photo you took with the app's camera (addEventPhoto), from every page it was on.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventPhotoRemove

fields.name: removeLocaleGuide
fields.description: Unlinks a local guide from its locale, so research no longer reads it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LocaleGuideRemove

fields.name: removeMyChatMessage
fields.description: Removes one of your own messages from its chat room. Everyone in the room stops seeing it at once.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessageRemoveOwn

fields.name: removePersonHeadshot
fields.description: Takes a headshot out of a performer's headshots. Posters already made keep it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonHeadshotRemove

fields.name: removePostComment
fields.description: Removes a comment on a post: its author's own, or any on a post for whoever manages its poster (the venue's managers, the talent listing's) and admins.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PostCommentRemove

fields.name: removePosterArt
fields.description: Removes a generated background or a commissioned poster. Posters already downloaded keep it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PosterArtRemove

fields.name: removeRoomChecklistItem
fields.description: Removes an item from a room's checklist. Whoever added it may, and the venue and admins.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomChecklistItemRemove

fields.name: removeRoomFile
fields.description: Deletes a file shared in a room, and its stored copy. Its uploader may, and the venue's managers and admins.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomFileRemove

fields.name: removeRoomMessage
fields.description: Removes something said or posted in a room, with its replies and the files it shared. Its writer may, and the venue's managers and admins.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomMessageRemove

fields.name: removeVenueBannerPhoto
fields.description: Takes an image out of a venue's banner images.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueBannerPhotoRemove

fields.name: renewEvaluationLease
fields.description: Keeps the lease on work this worker is still on for another ten minutes.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EvaluationLeaseRenew

fields.name: renewOnboardingInvite
fields.description: Gives a pending or expired invite a new code and expiry; the old code stops working.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for OnboardingInviteRenew

fields.name: reorderLineup
fields.description: Puts a night's lineups in a new running order. Each entry stays on its own lineup (the venue's or an event's): only the order within each changes.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LineupReorder

fields.name: reorderVenueBannerPhotos
fields.description: Puts a venue's banner images in this order. Name each of them once.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueBannerPhotosReorder

fields.name: reportChatMessage
fields.description: Reports a message in a venue's or locale's chat room to the audience's admins, who see it in the console's Reports queue at once and can remove it or ban the sender. Optionally blocks the sender too. A post as the venue or as a person can be reported like any other; blocking ignores it, since a listing has no sender to block. Same as reportContent with MESSAGE.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessageReport

fields.name: reportContent
fields.description: Reports a message, person, venue, ping, photo, post or comment to the audience's admins, who see it in the console's Reports queue at once. Optionally blocks the person responsible, when there is one: a message's sender (not for posts as the venue or a person), the person themself, a ping's sender, a comment's author.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ContentReport

fields.name: reportEventPhoto
fields.description: Reports a photographer's photo, for example a photo of yourself you want taken down. It's hidden at once, until the audience's admins look at it in the console's Reports queue; the photographer sees it was reported. reportContent with PHOTO does the same.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventPhotoReport

fields.name: reportLocation
fields.description: Records the user's position and returns the venue they're in, or what's near them.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LocationReport

fields.name: reportSafetyShiftPresence
fields.description: Reports whether this device is inside a venue, for a safety shift that follows the venue's geofence.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyShiftPresenceReport

fields.name: reportVenueOpen
fields.description: Says a venue reported closed is still open. A reviewer decides; the venue is back in tonight's views sooner when enough people (or its staff) say so.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueOpenReport

fields.name: requestSong
fields.description: Asks for a song, or signs up to sing one, in a venue's chat room. Everyone in the room sees the REQUEST line, and the host finds it in the queue. Refused while the venue is not taking requests of that kind (see Venue.requests for why).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SongRequestCreate

fields.name: resetAppReview
fields.description: Does what `rake app_review:reset` does: resets the sandbox reviewer account, refreshes the demo venue and its sample nights, sets the review code and turns App Review on for Hot Mess and AudienceKit Demo (AppReviewState). It also resets the second reviewer, banned from one Hot Mess venue, with its own code (AppReviewCode). Platform administrators only.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AppReviewReset

fields.name: resetAudienceInvite
fields.description: Makes a new invite link for the audience. The old link stops working; people who already joined keep their listings.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AudienceInviteReset

fields.name: resolveContentReport
fields.description: Resolves a report in the audience's Reports queue, and the other open reports on the same thing. removeContent takes the content down first (removes the message, hides the photo, ends the ping); banUser bans the person responsible from the audience, as banAudienceMember does.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ContentReportResolve

fields.name: respondToFriendRequest
fields.description: Answers a friend request someone sent the viewer. Accepting makes them friends and tells the sender; "Not now" hides it and tells nobody.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for FriendRequestRespond

fields.name: revealTriviaRound
fields.description: Takes the room's call and shows the answer now, without waiting for voting to close. On a segment that reveals answers at the end, closes its voting instead: the answer shows when the segment ends.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TriviaRoundReveal

fields.name: reviewSafetyAlert
fields.description: Records what the audience's team decided about a flagged safety alert, which takes it out of the needs-a-look list. It never bans anyone; banAudienceMember does that.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyAlertReview

fields.name: revokeEventAccess
fields.description: Takes back an event granted to a talent listing (grantEventAccess). Whoever may grant it revokes it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventAccessRevoke

fields.name: revokeObjectAccess
fields.description: Revokes an access grant from a subject.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AccessGrantRevoke

fields.name: revokeOnboardingInvite
fields.description: Stops a pending invite working. Access it already granted stays; remove that on the access list.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for OnboardingInviteRevoke

fields.name: revokeServiceToken
fields.description: Revokes a service token. It stops signing in at once; a JWT it already traded for lasts at most an hour.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ServiceTokenRevoke

fields.name: revokeVenueDevice
fields.description: Revokes a venue device and its unused code.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueDeviceRevoke

fields.name: rsvpEvent
fields.description: Sets the user's RSVP to an event in AudienceKit. It isn't sent to Facebook, which no longer lets apps RSVP for people. A ticket holder stays going whatever they answer.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventRSVP

fields.name: savePromoPlacement
fields.description: Books a promoted, charity or announcement card into the apps' layouts, or changes one when id is given. Where it shows is contextual only: screens, locales, nights and venue or event tags.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PromoPlacementSave

fields.name: scanAdmission
fields.description: Checks a pass's QR code at a venue's door. The first scan of a paid pass checks them in; later ones that night are re-entry.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AdmissionScan

fields.name: scanPairUpCode
fields.description: Scans a Quickie code. Your partner's confirms you met (both see You met!); someone else's gives the two of you a fresh topic instead. Anything else says why, without changing anything.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PairUpCodeScan

fields.name: seeSafetyAlert
fields.description: Records that this device opened a safety alert at its venue, so the guest knows someone saw it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyAlertSee

fields.name: sendChatMessage
fields.description: Posts to a venue's or a locale's chat room, as the signed-in admin (STAFF), as the venue (VENUE) or as a person (HOST). Everyone in the room sees it at once. Admins post as any; venue listing managers only as their venue; talent as a person they manage, in the rooms of the venues and locales they're featured in or host events at (Person.chat.rooms), from anywhere: text, a PHOTO or one of their EVENTs.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessageSend

fields.name: sendFriendRequest
fields.description: Asks someone contact matching found to be friends, and pushes them. Asking someone who already asked the viewer accepts their request.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for FriendRequestSend

fields.name: sendMyChatMessage
fields.description: Says something in a chat room as yourself. The message reaches everyone following the room at once.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessageSendOwn

fields.name: sendPing
fields.description: Tells friends the signed-in user wants to go out tonight, naming venues or events, or neither.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PingSend

fields.name: sendRoomMessage
fields.description: Says something in a room, or posts there (kind POST, with a title, which can be pinned and replied to), sharing the files uploaded for it (startRoomUpload). Name the room, or the venue, event or locale whose back-of-house room it is.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomMessageSend

fields.name: sendSafetyAlert
fields.description: Tells the staff on shift at the venue you're at that you feel unsafe (only while the app places you there). Where you are and what is going on are optional; send it first and add them after (updateSafetyAlert). While your alert there is open, sending again adds to it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyAlertSend

fields.name: sendSafetyAlertMessage
fields.description: Sends a message in a safety alert's private thread: from the guest who sent it while it is open, or from staff at its venue. Never shown in venue chat.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyAlertMessageSend

fields.name: setAiCapability
fields.description: Selects a linked provider and model for a capability. Omit provider to restore feature defaults.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AiCapabilitySet

fields.name: setAudienceAdmin
fields.description: Makes a member one of the audience's admins, or not. Takes effect when they next sign in.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AudienceAdminSet

fields.name: setChatChannel
fields.description: Makes a venue's or locale's room one of the chat provider's channels, e.g. a Discord channel, so the apps send people there. An empty channel clears it, and the room sends people to the invite.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatChannelSet

fields.name: setChatInitials
fields.description: Shows the signed-in user's initials in chat rooms instead of their photo, or their photo again.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatInitialsSet

fields.name: setContactMatchName
fields.description: Changes the first and last name friends match the viewer on. Their own codes follow at once.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ContactMatchNameSet

fields.name: setCoverNight
fields.description: Changes one night's cover at a venue whose door the caller works: another price, none, or other hours. It wins over the usual cover and over an event that night.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for CoverNightSet

fields.name: setEventChatPrompts
fields.description: Changes an event's chat prompts (Event.chat): whether and when its room shows them, and the list itself. A list replaces the one it has, in its order; prompts already shown tonight stay as they were, whatever the list says. starterSet starts the list from one of Event.chat.starterSets.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventChatPromptsSet

fields.name: setEventKaraoke
fields.description: Marks an event as a karaoke night, or not, and links it to the session singers join that night on its venue's karaoke partner. Without a session code of its own, a night uses its venue's standing one.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventKaraokeSet

fields.name: setPersonHeadshotApproval
fields.description: Approves a headshot for posters, or takes the approval back. Approving once covers every poster.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonHeadshotApprovalSet

fields.name: setPersonHeadshotCutout
fields.description: Replaces a headshot's cut-out with one made by hand, or with none and retry asks the background-removal service again.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonHeadshotCutoutSet

fields.name: setPersonLocale
fields.description: Features a person in one of the audience's locales, or stops featuring them there.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonLocaleSet

fields.name: setPersonSquareLocation
fields.description: Picks which of a performer's Square locations their tips are paid to.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonSquareLocationSet

fields.name: setPersonVisibility
fields.description: Sets who sees a performer: PUBLIC (the whole internet) or COMMUNITY (signed in), as their default or, with eventId, on one of their events. Only the performer makes themselves PUBLIC; a platform admin may with their in-person consent, saying so in note.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonVisibilitySet

fields.name: setReadiness
fields.description: Says who is ready for a curtain call: the venue, a performer or someone on the support staff. The show runs on GO (advanceLineup waits for it unless forced).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ReadinessSet

fields.name: setRecentChatPush
fields.description: Turns on or off pushes about new messages in chat rooms the signed-in user left in the last 30 minutes (at most one every 10 minutes per room). Off until they turn it on.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RecentChatPushSet

fields.name: setRoomTrackNeeded
fields.description: Says whether an act on an event's lineup needs a track in the event's back-of-house room. Performers' acts need one unless someone says not; others don't unless someone says they do. The venue's managers and staff, admins, the event's hosts and the act's own people may (RoomAccess#trusted_with?).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomTrackNeededSet

fields.name: setSafetyShift
fields.description: Turns this device's safety alerts at a venue on or off, and sets the first name guests see when it picks one up.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyShiftSet

fields.name: setSongRequestState
fields.description: Moves a song request or karaoke signup along: UP calls it (playing now, or the singer is on, announced in the room; whatever was up goes back to QUEUED), DONE and SKIPPED finish it, QUEUED puts it back. For admins, the venue's managers and the host on now.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SongRequestSetState

fields.name: setTribes
fields.description: Replaces the signed-in user's tribes here with these, for the picker's Done. Tribes they keep keep their privacy; new ones are private. Refused, changing nothing, past audience.tribeCap tribes.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TribeSet

fields.name: setVenueSquareLocation
fields.description: Picks which of the venue's Square locations its cover is paid to.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueSquareLocationSet

fields.name: sharePairUp
fields.description: Agrees to share your meeting in the venue's chat. Once both of you have, the venue posts your names (first name and last initial) and your topic.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PairUpShare

fields.name: shareSafetyAlertSupport
fields.description: Shares "Need support?" (crisis and support lines) with the guest who sent a safety alert at your venue, open or closed, with a note if you like.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyAlertSupportShare

fields.name: showEventPhoto
fields.description: Shows a hidden or reported photo in the apps again.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventPhotoShow

fields.name: showNextChatPrompt
fields.description: Puts an event's next chat prompt up in its venue's room now, pinned under the title, without waiting for the rotation: for whoever runs the night (Velvet, Backstage, Focus). It goes up even past the nightly cap, while an act is on, or with prompts off; the rotation counts on from it. Name the event (id), which must be on now, or the venue (venueId) for the latest event on there now with prompts left.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatPromptShowNext

fields.name: showPairUpCode
fields.description: A fresh QR code to show your partner once you both accept. It works once, only for them, and replaces the one you showed before.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PairUpCodeShow

fields.name: skipPairUp
fields.description: Skips the topic for a new one (both accept again), or the partner: both look for someone new and aren't paired together again tonight.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PairUpSkip

fields.name: startAiProviderSignIn
fields.description: Starts a single-use AI provider sign-in for this audience and admin.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AiProviderSignIn

fields.name: startContactPhoneVerification
fields.description: Saves the name friends will match the viewer on and texts a six-digit code to their mobile number (verifyContactPhone). Up to five codes a day, 30 seconds apart.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ContactPhoneVerificationStart

fields.name: startMaintenanceRun
fields.description: Starts a maintenance operation on the worker. On an audience’s endpoint it runs for that audience; on the tenants endpoint it runs for audienceId, or platform-wide without one.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for MaintenanceRunStart

fields.name: startRoomUpload
fields.description: Starts uploading a file to a room: PUT its bytes to `uploadUrl` within 30 minutes, with the same Content-Type (or, from a browser, POST them in `partSize` parts to `partsPath`), then confirm it (finishRoomUpload) and share it (sendRoomMessage fileIds). Sound, pictures, video and documents (PDF, text, office files, zip), up to 200 MB. A file not shared within a day is deleted. Name the room, or the venue, event or locale whose back-of-house room it is.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomUploadStart

fields.name: startTip
fields.description: Starts tipping a performer in the app, through their own Stripe or Square account (the IN_APP option of their tipping mixin). Stripe: finish with Stripe's payment sheet (paymentIntentClientSecret, on their account stripeAccountId, with publishableKey), then call confirmTip. Square: make a payment token with Square's In-App Payments SDK (squareApplicationId, squareLocationId), then call payTip with it. Asking again for the same amount soon after returns the same tip.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TipStart

fields.name: submitContribution
fields.description: Suggests a missing venue or event, a correction, a closure, a tag or a performer for the audience's listings. A reviewer decides; nothing changes until they approve. Local rules are corrected with submitLocalRulesCorrection, by venue staff.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ContributionSubmit

fields.name: submitLocalRulesCorrection
fields.description: Suggests a correction to a venue's local rules, as its verified staff. A reviewer decides; age policy and licence class changes need a link or photo, and the public licence record outranks the venue's claim.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LocalRulesCorrectionSubmit

fields.name: unbanAudienceMember
fields.description: Lets a banned member sign in and chat again.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AudienceMemberUnban

fields.name: unblockUser
fields.description: Unblocks someone the signed-in user blocked.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for BlockedUserRemove

fields.name: unlinkAiProvider
fields.description: Forgets this audience’s credentials and cancels pending sign-ins. Explicit capability choices remain disconnected until relinked or reset. Revoke access at the provider separately.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AiProviderLinkDelete

fields.name: updateAppearance
fields.description: Changes someone's appearance at a venue.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AppearanceUpdate

fields.name: updateArbiterPrompt
fields.description: Sets an audience's own text for one of Arbiter's prompts, or (a blank body) goes back to the default.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ArbiterPromptUpdate

fields.name: updateArbiterSettings
fields.description: Sets how Arbiter, the Mac moderator and AI host, judges and hosts for an audience. Omitted or null arguments keep their value; guardThresholds and ruleThresholds replace the whole list given.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ArbiterSettingsUpdate

fields.name: updateAudience
fields.description: Renames an audience, changes its subdomain, links its Facebook Page, sets the App Review period of its apps or chooses how people sign in to its apps and the warnings they see first. Subdomains and Pages change only from /v1/tenants/graphql.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AudienceUpdate

fields.name: updateAudienceTheme
fields.description: Replaces an audience's theme: its design system preset, tagline and color overrides.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for AudienceThemeUpdate

fields.name: updateChatMessage
fields.description: Edits an announcement or special: its title, its body, or when a special ends. An endsAt of now or earlier ends the special at once.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatMessageUpdate

fields.name: updateEvent
fields.description: Changes one of the audience's events.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventUpdate

fields.name: updateEventSeries
fields.description: Changes one of the audience's recurring series. Its upcoming occurrences follow, except ones edited on their own.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for EventSeriesUpdate

fields.name: updateLineup
fields.description: Changes a lineup's hosts, billing, scene setting or (a zone's night) hours.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LineupUpdate

fields.name: updateLineupTask
fields.description: Ticks, unticks, removes, puts back or rewords a lineup entry's task. Fields left out aren't changed. Anyone working the show ticks; whoever may change the lineup removes, puts back and rewords (only an entry's own task has words of its own).

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LineupTaskUpdate

fields.name: updateLocale
fields.description: Changes one of the audience's locales.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for LocaleUpdate

fields.name: updatePerson
fields.description: Changes one of the audience's people. Listing managers change only their own name, website, photo and social links, and those of troupes they are in, all but the troupe's tip links.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PersonUpdate

fields.name: updatePhotographer
fields.description: Changes a photographer's grant: their name, the metros it covers, or whether it's revoked. Revoking hides every photo credited to them here; restoring shows them again.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PhotographerUpdate

fields.name: updatePost
fields.description: Changes a venue's or a person's post. Fields left out aren't changed.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PostUpdate

fields.name: updatePromoCardCopy
fields.description: Replaces the audience's own words for promoted cards: category names and descriptions ("Cards you see") and the badges (Promoted, Charity, Announcement). The apps get them with the next layout, no app release needed. What's left out goes back to the default.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for PromoCardCopyUpdate

fields.name: updateRoomChecklistItem
fields.description: Ticks, unticks or rewords an item on a room's checklist. Fields left out are not changed. Anyone in the room may tick; whoever added it, the venue and admins may reword it.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomChecklistItemUpdate

fields.name: updateRoomMessage
fields.description: Changes something said or posted in a room, or pins or unpins a post. Fields left out are not changed. Its writer may, and the venue's managers and admins.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for RoomMessageUpdate

fields.name: updateSafetyAlert
fields.description: Adds where you are and what is going on to your open safety alert. Concerns add to the ones you picked; left-out arguments keep what you said.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SafetyAlertUpdate

fields.name: updateStaffAssignment
fields.description: Changes someone on a show's support staff.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for StaffAssignmentUpdate

fields.name: updateStageZone
fields.description: Renames, moves or makes default a venue's zone.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for StageZoneUpdate

fields.name: updateTag
fields.description: Renames or recolors one of the audience's tags, everywhere it is applied.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TagUpdate

fields.name: updateTaskTemplate
fields.description: Changes a lineup task template. Its tasks on every entry follow; ticks and removals stay.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TaskTemplateUpdate

fields.name: updateTicketingAccount
fields.description: Changes a connected ticketing account, and with sync imports its events again now.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TicketingAccountUpdate

fields.name: updateVenue
fields.description: Changes one of the audience's venues. Listing managers change only the name, description, website, social links and cover of their own.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueUpdate

fields.name: updateVenueCover
fields.description: Sets the usual cover for a venue whose door the caller manages.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueCoverUpdate

fields.name: uploadListings
fields.description: Uploads a listings file and starts its dry run on the worker: a calendar site’s listings (CalendarSiteImport: {source, regions, venues, events}, such as thegaycal.com’s), or a researched list of locales and their bars, People, or social profiles (the files listings:locales, listings:people, listings:socials and listings:propose_socials take). The file’s kind is read from its shape unless given. Nothing is imported until importListings.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ListingImportUpload

fields.name: verifyChat
fields.description: Checks the audience's stored chat bot token with its provider, without changing anything there.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ChatVerify

fields.name: verifyContactPhone
fields.description: Checks the code startContactPhoneVerification texted. Right, the number is theirs: it moves off any other account that had it. Five tries per code.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for ContactPhoneVerify

fields.name: verifyVenueKaraoke
fields.description: Checks a venue's stored karaoke API token with its partner, without changing anything there.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for VenueKaraokeVerify

fields.name: voteTrivia
fields.description: Votes in a trivia round: someone at the venue picks a choice (changing it is fine while voting is open). Only counts are shown; nobody is named or scored.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for TriviaVoteCast

fields.name: withdrawSongRequest
fields.description: Takes back a song request or karaoke signup of yours that is still waiting. Its chat line shows it withdrawn.

args.name: input
args.description: Parameters for SongRequestWithdraw

types.name: MutationChatView
types.description: The local implementation of the chat mutations.

fields.name: moderation
fields.description: What a moderation provider does about the feed.

fields.description: ID of the object.

enumValues.description: It changed: `fields` says which of its own fields.

enumValues.name: DELETED
enumValues.description: It's gone.

fields.name: change
fields.description: What happened to it.

fields.name: fields
fields.description: The fields of its own that changed, as GraphQL names them; empty when it's deleted.

fields.name: id

args.description: Follows the room without being in it: no presence, so nobody sees the subscriber as in chat. For a glimpse of the room, like ChatPeek.

args.description: The room's UUID.

args.name: venueId

types.name: __Directive
types.description:
A Directive provides a way to describe alternate runtime execution and type validation behavior in a GraphQL document.

In some cases, you need to provide options to alter GraphQL's execution behavior in ways field arguments will not suffice, such as conditionally including or skipping a field. Directives provide this by describing additional information to the executor.

types.name: __DirectiveLocation
types.description: A Directive can be adjacent to many parts of the GraphQL language, a __DirectiveLocation describes one such possible adjacencies.

enumValues.name: QUERY
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a query operation.

enumValues.name: MUTATION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a mutation operation.

enumValues.name: SUBSCRIPTION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a subscription operation.

enumValues.name: FIELD
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a field.

enumValues.name: FRAGMENT_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a fragment definition.

enumValues.name: FRAGMENT_SPREAD
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a fragment spread.

enumValues.name: INLINE_FRAGMENT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an inline fragment.

enumValues.name: VARIABLE_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a variable definition.

enumValues.name: SCHEMA
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a schema definition.

enumValues.name: SCALAR
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a scalar definition.

enumValues.name: OBJECT
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an object type definition.

enumValues.name: FIELD_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a field definition.

enumValues.name: ARGUMENT_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an argument definition.

enumValues.name: INTERFACE
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an interface definition.

enumValues.name: UNION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to a union definition.

enumValues.name: ENUM
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an enum definition.

enumValues.name: ENUM_VALUE
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an enum value definition.

enumValues.name: INPUT_OBJECT

enumValues.name: INPUT_FIELD_DEFINITION
enumValues.description: Location adjacent to an input object field definition.

types.name: __Field
types.description: Object and Interface types are described by a list of Fields, each of which has a name, potentially a list of arguments, and a return type.

types.name: __InputValue
types.description: Arguments provided to Fields or Directives and the input fields of an InputObject are represented as Input Values which describe their type and optionally a default value.

types.name: __Schema
types.description: A GraphQL Schema defines the capabilities of a GraphQL server. It exposes all available types and directives on the server, as well as the entry points for query, mutation, and subscription operations.

fields.name: directives
fields.description: A list of all directives supported by this server.

fields.name: mutationType
fields.description: If this server supports mutation, the type that mutation operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: queryType
fields.description: The type that query operations will be rooted at.

fields.name: subscriptionType
fields.description: If this server support subscription, the type that subscription operations will be rooted at.

types.name: __Type
types.description:
The fundamental unit of any GraphQL Schema is the type. There are many kinds of types in GraphQL as represented by the `__TypeKind` enum.

Depending on the kind of a type, certain fields describe information about that type. Scalar types provide no information beyond a name and description, while Enum types provide their values. Object and Interface types provide the fields they describe. Abstract types, Union and Interface, provide the Object types possible at runtime. List and NonNull types compose other types.

types.name: __TypeKind
types.description: An enum describing what kind of type a given `__Type` is.

enumValues.name: SCALAR
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a scalar.

enumValues.name: OBJECT
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an object. `fields` and `interfaces` are valid fields.

enumValues.name: INTERFACE
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an interface. `fields` and `possibleTypes` are valid fields.

enumValues.name: UNION
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a union. `possibleTypes` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: ENUM
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an enum. `enumValues` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: INPUT_OBJECT
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is an input object. `inputFields` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: LIST
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a list. `ofType` is a valid field.

enumValues.name: NON_NULL
enumValues.description: Indicates this type is a non-null. `ofType` is a valid field.
